cohort: 31,509 pregnant women admitted to an obstetric emergency hospital in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, between 2013 and 2018
finding: Antenatal care attendance is crucial to prevent and treat pregnancy complications and reduce the risk of stillbirth and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Caesarean section significantly increased the risk of maternal death but reduced the risk of stillbirth in women with complicated pregnancies and pre-eclampsia.
